app.title: Tartessos Quest
app.subtitle: The mysteries beneath the southern sands

level00.imageAlt: Archaeological excavation camp in an ancient marshland
level00.captionInitial: You have arrived at the excavation camp.
level00.title: Tartessos Quest
level00.paragraph1: An archaeological expedition has discovered a sealed entrance beneath the southern sands. The first clues point to a forgotten chamber of ancient Tartessos.
level00.paragraph2: No one knows what lies beyond the threshold. The inscriptions found so far have not yet been translated; the ancient Tartessian language remains a mystery.
level00.paragraph3: Your mission is to accompany the expedition, decipher its signs, and advance step by step toward the heart of a lost civilization.
level00.paragraph4: Each chamber will reveal part of the mystery. Each decision will bring the expedition closer to the truth Tartessos left buried.
level00.successParagraph2: The expedition can begin the descent toward the first Tartessian threshold.
level00.hint: Next mission: proceed to the expedition registry.

level01.captionInitial: The expedition’s first registry awaits you on the campaign table.
level01.captionCompleted: You have been registered as a member of the expedition.
level01.title: ADVENTURER NAME
level01.paragraph1: Before crossing the threshold, the expedition must record the names of those who will descend into the sealed chambers.
level01.paragraph2: The registry lies open on a table covered with maps, compasses, and ceramic fragments marked with ancient signs.
level01.paragraph3: Once your name has been entered, the expedition guide will give the signal to continue toward the main entrance.
level01.helpIntro: To complete this exercise, you must modify a class parameter in ObjectScript and compile the class.
level01.helpStep3: Replace the value CHANGE_ME with your name.
level01.helpStep4: Compile the class from VS Code or from the IRIS terminal.
level01.helpStep5: Press SUBMIT FORM to run the validation.
level01.helpExpectedText: The GetAdventurerName method must return your name and store it in the ^adventurerName global.
level01.successMessage: The form has been received successfully.
level01.genericValidationError: The form could not be validated.
level01.connectionError: Could not contact the registration post.
level01.formNotCompletedError: The form has not been completed.

level02.captionInitial: The campaign cabinet holds the expedition’s basic equipment.
level02.title: THE EXCAVATION KIT
level02.paragraph1: Before entering the work area, the foreman points to an old wooden cabinet reinforced with iron.
level02.paragraph2: Its shelves hold tools worn by previous campaigns: dust-covered hats, flashlights, boxes of batteries, and excavation instruments.
level02.paragraph3: Nothing must be missing before leaving camp. The expedition will only move forward once the equipment has been checked.
level02.helpIntro: To complete this exercise, you must implement a class method that prepares tools using conditions and loops.
level02.helpStep2: Find the PrepareTool(tool As %String, total As %Integer) method.
level02.helpStep3: Check the value of tool using If statements.
level02.helpStep4: For each valid tool, create a For loop from 1 to total.
level02.helpStep5: Inside each loop, call the corresponding method from Tartessos.Quest.ExcavationKitUtils.
level02.helpStep6: Use AddTrowel(), AddHat(), AddFlashlight(), or AddBattery() as appropriate.
level02.helpStep7: Return 1 if the tool is valid and 0 if it is not. Compile the class before reviewing the kit.
level02.helpExpectedText: The validation will call PrepareTool with a test value and check that each tool global contains the expected quantity.
level02.genericValidationError: The equipment is not ready yet.
level02.connectionError: Could not contact the tool station.

level03.imageAlt: Underground passage with access to several chambers and a central collapse
level03.captionInitial: The first passage of the hypogeum branches into chambers that have not yet been classified.
level03.captionCompleted: The initial chamber map has been organized.
level03.title: DISCOVERING THE CHAMBERS
level03.paragraph1: The descent leads into a stone passage. Dark entrances open on both sides, while a collapse blocks the central path.
level03.paragraph2: The marks on the walls suggest that not every chamber served the same purpose. Some look like corridors, others like gathering halls, burial spaces, or sealed storage rooms.
level03.paragraph3: Before moving forward, the expedition must organize the first map of the ruins and classify each type of chamber.
level03.helpTitle: How to define the chamber model
level03.helpIntro: To complete this exercise, you must create a set of ObjectScript classes using packages, inheritance, and typed properties.
level03.helpStep3: Make Chamber extend %RegisteredObject and mark it as Abstract.
level03.helpStep4: Add the Code, Name, Description, Level, and IsSealed properties to Chamber.
level03.helpStep5: Create the Corridor, Hall, Mortuary, and Storage classes in the same package.
level03.helpStep6: Make all specific classes extend Tartessos.Quest.Chambers.Chamber.
level03.helpStep7: Add the Length and HasFork properties to Corridor.
level03.helpStep8: Add the specific properties for Hall, Mortuary, and Storage according to the exercise statement.
level03.helpStep9: Compile the Tartessos.Quest.Chambers package and press REVIEW CHAMBERS.
level03.helpExpectedText: The validation will check that the classes exist, that inheritance is correct, and that the properties have the expected types and initial values.
level03.successMessage: The first chamber model has been recognized.
level03.genericValidationError: Not all chamber types have been recognized.
level03.connectionError: Could not contact the excavation chief.
